title: Chuyên đề Tin học quản lý đầu tư

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Apply financial functions to assess the financial effectiveness of projects.
Use project management software such as Microsoft Project for planning, managing progress, resources, costs, and monitoring projects.
Apply Excel functions to evaluate financial effectiveness, select investment options, and analyze sensitivity.
Understand and apply the process of project planning using MS Excel and MS Project.
Develop the ability to learn independently, identify problems, analyze and solve them.
Collaborate effectively with team members to complete group tasks.
Think critically about project management issues and solutions.
Utilize Microsoft Excel for financial analysis and project planning.
Utilize Microsoft Project for project planning, resource management, and cost control.
